subject.title: fix(telegram): Allow multi-agent ACP bindings within same account

question: Should same-account Telegram ACP bindings in one group topic be true simultaneous bindings, or an explicit last-writer-wins handoff?
rationale: The PR body promises independent bindings, but the current binding service resolves one binding per account/conversation and the added test asserts replacement, so maintainer intent is needed before choosing the durable model.

options.title: Require True Multi-Binding
options.body: Accept this direction only if routing, list, touch, and unbind semantics preserve both same-topic sessions and tests prove both remain reachable.

options.title: Document Same-Account Handoff
options.body: Allow last-writer-wins only if the PR description, tests, and user proof describe an intentional ownership switch rather than independent sessions.

options.title: Pause The PR
options.body: Leave the PR blocked until a narrower maintainer-sponsored design defines how Telegram same-topic ACP ownership should work.

recommendation.title: Require True Multi-Binding
recommendation.body: Accept this direction only if routing, list, touch, and unbind semantics preserve both same-topic sessions and tests prove both remain reachable.

likelyOwner.reason: The current storage and migration implementation is most directly tied to recent Vincent Koc history in the affected files.
